section: Plan Migration · IDD Balance & HKD Settlement
content:
**Cross-plan migration (Professional → Enterprise)**

- IDD (International Direct Dialling) minute balance carry-over across plan tiers is subject to billing and compliance approval — not automatic. Minutes carry over to the new plan only after contract addendum is signed.
- Annual prepayment invoicing in corporate HKD is supported for Enterprise and Enterprise Plus customers with verified billing entity in Hong Kong.
- Specific terms (proration, rollover window, refund eligibility) require sign-off from the billing/compliance team — AI assistant cannot confirm final terms.
